content:
After the Liquid Glass redesign officially reaches most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Details below.

New chat bubbles look more rounded

Several months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out the Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, following months of testing and refinement, with selected users trying it out via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted clues in the app's code suggesting that WhatsApp chat bubbles would be redesigned. The site now reports that the new bubble design is beginning to roll out to some users running the latest TestFlight version.

Here's what WABetaInfo says:

In addition to changing the shape of message bubbles, the new design also alters how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around photo, video, GIF and link previews, giving the interface a cleaner look that blends in with the conversation.

According to WABetaInfo, the new interface is currently only available to some users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version. As for when it will be rolled out more broadly to all iOS users, there is no news for now.
